narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On August 8, 2024, at approximately 1240 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at a dairy farm near Coopersville, Michigan. The subject stated that he is a citizen of Mexico and that he does not have permission to be in the United States.
TRAVEL:
The subject stated that he left Oaxaca in 2014 and worked in Tijuana for three years, then moved to Mexicali in 2017.
In August 2018 he crossed into the United States by walking through the desert west of Calexico, California.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Notice to Appear.
